title: CheckpointManifest
description: Metadata required for a reproducible model checkpoint. An approved checkpoint is reproducible (artifact_uri + sha256 + dataset + preprocessing + normalization + config hashes), never just an unmanaged final_model.pt (RULE 13).

architecture.description: Architecture/config name (matches an entry in config/model.yaml).

artifact_uri.description: Location in object storage / model registry (never in Git).

sha256.description: Content hash of the checkpoint artifact.

dataset_manifest.description: Reference to the exact dataset manifest used for training.

preprocessing_version.description: Version of the preprocessing pipeline that produced training inputs.

normalization_version.description: Version of the normalization statistics applied to inputs (RULE 11).

configuration_hash.description: Hash of the resolved training/model configuration.

trained_on.description: End date of the training data period, not a claim of realtime capability.
